title: fix(fields): lazy field widgets load again after a failed chunk load
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8Jauz9zBKmCvktkHXwUiSe1)_

Fixes #36608

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：表单和列表里的日期、日期时间、富文本、筛选条件、图片裁剪等控件，某次加载失败（刚发版换了文件、网络断了一下）后，重新打开表单或页面即可恢复，不用再整页刷新。
- 为什么做：同类问题之前只修了明细行表格这一处，这次把字段包里其余所有延迟加载的控件一次收口到同一个机制上。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个控件在首次加载时多等一下或仍显示加载失败，可直接撤回本次改动，不涉及数据。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- New internal helper `ui/packages/fields/src/recoverableLazy.ts` (not exported from the package entry). It is `React.lazy` with one difference: a failed chunk load is not kept for the session.
  - Loading and loaded behave as `React.lazy`: the mount suspends to the host's nearest `Suspense` boundary, a mount after the chunk loaded renders in the same pass, and every mount shares one request. Hosts that wait on `Suspense` to reveal a form body keep doing so.
  - A failed load resolves to a stand-in that commits once (draws nothing), retires that request, then throws the failure from its next render to the nearest error boundary. The committed mount keeps rethrowing for as long as it is re-rendered; only a NEW mount (an error boundary's reset, a reopened form, a revisited page) asks for the chunk again.
- Every `React.lazy` site in the fields package now goes through it: `FieldEditWidget` (date, datetime, the rich text cell-panel editor), `richTextDisplay` (markdown read face), `FilterConditionCell`, `ImageField`'s crop dialog, `getLazyFieldWidget`, and `registerField` (the form registry path; the card's re-check grep lists it, so it is in scope). `git grep -n "React.lazy\|lazy(" ui/packages/fields/src` now hits only the helper and comments.
- The returned component also carries `load()`, which resolves to the loaded widget itself through the same shared request (and asks again after a failure). `getLazyFieldWidget`'s declared return type is unchanged (`React.ComponentType`); `load()` is the seam for a caller that needs the widget's own function rather than an element of it.
- `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx` read `React.lazy`'s private `_init`/`_payload` off `getLazyFieldWidget`'s result to reach each widget's render function; it now calls `load()`. CI caught this at b572a585 (`Test UI (13/16)`: `TypeError: internals._init is not a function`); at 672b03e0 that file passes locally (37 tests).
- `GridField` keeps its own loader from #36607 unchanged.
- Patch changeset for `@object-ui/fields`.

### Why not #36607's effect-based wrapper as is

The card suggests #36607's approach. That wrapper loads from an effect and draws its own loading face, so it never suspends. Applied to `getLazyFieldWidget` / `registerField`, every cold-loaded form field would stop suspending to its host's `Suspense` fallback (the form bodies' pending skeletons, the action dialogs' widget fallbacks) and the host would reveal half-loaded forms. The helper keeps `Suspense` on the happy path and borrows #36607's key idea only on the failure path: a request is forgotten only from a committed mount, so the failure is shown instead of retried in a loop.

The tempting simpler variant (forget the failed request in the render that throws) is wrong, and the second ablation below shows it: a mount that never committed keeps no state, so React's re-render after the rejection picks a fresh request, suspends again, and the error never reaches the boundary.

## Tests

`ui/packages/fields/src/__tests__/lazyWidgetRecovery-36608.test.tsx`, 12 tests:

- the helper: suspends to the host fallback, later mounts render in the same pass, concurrent mounts share one request, a failure reaches the boundary with exactly one request (no retry loop), the next mount loads; the same under `StrictMode`.
- one pin per site (date, datetime, rich text panel editor, markdown read face, filter-condition cell, image crop dialog, `getLazyFieldWidget('date')`, `registerField('date')`): the chunk module is mocked to fail its first import, the first mount lands on the error boundary, a later mount renders the widget.

One family file rather than a pin per component file: every site pin needs `vi.resetModules` plus a module mock of that site's chunk, which would leak into the existing shared files' other tests.

## Acceptance notes

- None filed. Nothing out of scope was found.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/lazyWidgetRecovery-36608.test.tsx`, expect 12 passed.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/fields/src/recoverableLazy.ts`, the whole file (the stand-in's commit-then-throw is the part that matters).
2. `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `getLazyFieldWidget` and `registerField`.
3. `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`, the three lazy editors.

<details><summary>Local readings at head 672b03e0</summary>

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/src/__tests__/lazyWidgetRecovery-36608.test.tsx examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 49 passed (12 new pins, one of them also pinning `load()`, plus the census).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields test`: Test Files 326 passed, 1 skipped (327); Tests 4980 passed, 7 skipped (4987). Run at c42f157f plus the typing fix; the later commits touch the helper's `load()`, the new test file and the census test, all re-run above, and `type-check` re-ran at 672b03e0: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` (both tsc programs; the new test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program, `--listFiles` counts 1): exit 0.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, restore proven by blob equals HEAD and empty `git diff HEAD`); the tests import source, so no rebuild leg:
  1. the stand-in never retires its request (`attempt.retired = false`): 10 of 12 red (both helper failure pins and all 8 site pins).
  2. the naive variant (retire and throw in the same render, no commit first): both helper failure pins red; the first mount shows the widget, not the error boundary, because the failure was swallowed and retried behind the loading face.
  3. `getLazyFieldWidget` back on `React.lazy`: its site pin red.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`), exit codes captured before any pipe: 36 run, all exit 0, including `check:type-check-debt`, `check:test-source-alias` (first red on a dynamic `@object-ui/core` import inside a test body, fixed by a module-top import), `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:engine-double-contract`, the changeset gates and `check-adr-0087-registration`. Left to CI: `check:published-files`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`.
- `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before each push: VERDICT clean (origin/main merges cleanly, 0 open PR heads share a file).

</details>
